bug_summary: RouteHeadersミドルウェアで空ルーター時にreturn文が抜けており、next.ServeHTTPが二重に呼ばれていた
pr_title: Simplify empty-route branch in HeaderRouter middleware
pr_description: The empty-router branch of `HeaderRouter.Handler` returned right after calling `next.ServeHTTP`, even though that was the last statement executed for this case anyway. Dropping the explicit return lets the function fall through the same code path uniformly instead of special-casing the empty-router case, which keeps the branch shorter and easier to follow.
